title: Hosted Interaction Pack PRD — modular lanes, canary ramp & traffic safety checklist
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Ship a composable "Hosted Interaction Pack" that bundles chat, completion, embeddings and rerank endpoints into a consistent developer surface with explicit traffic safety rules and a canary ramp process. This PRD clarifies scope, lists non-goals, defines measurable acceptance criteria, and provides a step-by-step launch checklist and runbook hooks for SRE and support.
scope_clarifications: Included: chat (multi-turn with token-limited context), single-call completions, embeddings v2, and a server-side reranker service that consumes embeddings + base model features.
Included: streaming generation for chat and completions in the hosted lane (SDK + HTTP chunked).
Included: per-tenant cost-visibility telemetry and per-route 99th/95th latency buckets in Console.
Excluded: first-party fine-tuning and customer-managed model uploads (Private/Dedicated will handle these).
Excluded: long-term KV persistence and on-disk conversational memory — ephemeral prefix caching only for inference latency optimizations.
constraints_and_tradeoffs: To meet latency SLOs we will prefer quantized model variants for the default lane; higher-accuracy (float32) variants are available as opt-in profiles with higher cost.
Batching aggressiveness is capped by slotized latency budgets per-lane; some micro-optimizations will be disabled in the first launch to reduce risk.
Streaming contract will use the existing SDK wire format; we defer callback-level function calling orchestration to a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: API contract: /v1/hosted/chat, /v1/hosted/completions, /v1/hosted/embeddings, /v1/hosted/rerank documented and validated by contract tests.
Latency: 95th percentile tail for chat/completions under baseline traffic <= 250ms for short prompts (<128 tokens) and <= 650ms for 1024-token responses.
Cost: median per-token cost for default lane within 10% of targeted cost profile in Optimize recommendations.
Reliability: 99.95% success rate for production canary slice over 72h with no customer-facing errors exceeding 0.1%.
Quality: embeddings cosine similarity recall >= 0.92 on curated evaluation corpus; reranker increases MRR by at least 8% on evaluation set versus base ordering.
Determinism: For deterministic mode, identical prompt+seed+model must produce identical tokens for 99.9% of sampled runs.
Security: KMS-backed key usage validated and audit logs show encryption-at-rest for persisted artifacts; security review signoff captured.
Observability: Token-level cost traces, per-model p50/p95/p99 latency, error breakdown, and an SLO dashboard exist and are linked in the runbook.
launch_checklist: Pre-launch: PRD reviewed and approved by Product, Eng, Design, and Security.
Pre-launch: API schema published and automated contract tests added to CI with golden responses for deterministic mode.
Pre-launch: SDK updates (python/js/go) published to beta registries with streaming examples and quickstart notebooks.
Pre-launch: Console pages for per-route cost & latency pinned to the release dashboard; synthetic traffic jobs configured.
Canary config: Create canary slices: 1% internal traffic (dev), 5% pilot customers, 10% early adopter cohort with automated rollback triggers.
Canary config: Traffic ramp schedule (1% -> 5% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100%) with minimum observation windows (24h/48h/72h) between steps.
Ops runbooks: Playbook for degradations (fallback to lower-quality variant, region failover, model variant fallback) published and tested.
Monitoring: Alerts configured for error-rate > 0.2%, p95 latency exceed target by 3x baseline, model OOM/eviction events; alert runbooks linked.
Safety nets: Rate-limiter defaults and per-tenant burst controls enabled to prevent noisy-neighbor amplification.
Documentation: Public API docs, migration notes for existing endpoints, and a short FAQ for customers about quality vs cost tradeoffs published.
Billing: metering hooks validated and billing preview available for sample tenants to verify charge calculations.
Security & compliance: SSO/SAML and audit log ingestion validated for hosted endpoints; custom KMS integration smoke-tested.
Launch: Feature flags ready with targeted audience gating; launch owner and incident commander assigned for day 0.
Post-launch: 7-day stabilization monitoring plan with daily syncs between Eng/PM/SRE and a quality regression slack channel.
Post-launch: Customer communication draft for GA with migration guidance prepared and reviewed by Growth.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dev-only exposure (1%), Phase 1: pilot customers (5%) with opt-in, Phase 2: early-adopters + current hosted customers (10-25%), Phase 3: general availability. Each phase requires green lights on quality, latency, and cost metrics with a minimum observation window. Automatic rollback if error-rate thresholds or SLO breaches occur.
monitoring_and_alerts: Dashboard links: hosted-api/interaction-pack/overview (p50/p95/p99, errors, cost per token).
Synthetic jobs: per-route long/short prompt sweeps every 5 minutes with anomaly detection.
SLO alerts: burn-rate alerting for 2x and 5x burn with escalation to incident commander.
Model health: OOM counters, eviction traces, and KV cache hit-rate tracked per model-variant.
Quality monitors: daily eval runs against seeded prompts to detect regression > 3% in MRR or embedding recall.
docs_and_sdk_updates: SDK changelog entries for streaming and deterministic mode; code samples for chat+embeddings+rerganrk (typo intentional?)
Quickstart notebooks: chat_streaming.ipynb, embeddings_search_demo.ipynb, rerank_workflow.md in the docs repo.
Console guide: How to interpret per-route cost breakdown and toggle lane profiles (default vs accuracy-focused).
post_launch_todos: Collect first-month usage data and re-evaluate default quantization profile based on cost/quality tradeoffs.
Ship function-calling orchestration as follow-up (scoped to dedicated lanes) after stability confirmed.
Refine canary ramp automation and integrate a/b evaluation hooks for quality regressions.
notes: Decision: default lane will use quantized variant to control cost; accuracy lane available behind opt-in flag.
Risk: Rerank depends on embedding stability; if embeddings drift, will fall back to base ordering and open a mitigation ticket.
Follow-ups: gating for regional fallbacks and cross-region SLOs are tracked in PM-994321.
